task.description:
WF-02, step 5b, pass 1 of 3 - gate on the tests of REQ-105 written by TEST-DESIGNER at step 5: tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js (E2S-01..E2S-20, new), tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js (nine tests with the real Chrome: matrix, pass, themes, keyboard, storage, isolation, not found, no connection, v3), tools/test/fixtures/e2e-stand/specs/sleep-stand.e2e.js (new), and the replaced guard tests E2K-50, E2K-41, E2K-60 in tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js. Follow the section 'Step 5b' of docs/workflows/WF-02-development.md item by item, and the design docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md sections 8, 11, 12, 13 and 16.

WHAT TO CHECK: (1) read the tests yourself; map every criterion of REQ-105 (all ten) to a runnable test and say where each is checked; no skip, todo or a skip word, no sandbox flags (section 3 of the design); failure tests check that the state is unchanged; each test has its own data and runs alone; no secrets, no absolute machine paths, no names of the owner's other projects; no sleep: waits for facts with limits, and a kill is followed by a wait for ESRCH, never one immediate check (decisions/0108 addendum, ISS-0103). (2) Run the tests yourself: the two kit files (node --test test/e2e-kit.test.js test/e2e-stand.test.js) three times in a row; npm run -s e2e -- picker three times in a row; npm run -s e2e once; the independence loop of REQ-104 criterion 7 on picker.e2e.js (each of the nine names alone: exit 0, exactly one line that starts with 'ok ', and it is 'ok 1 - <name>') and each E2S test alone; a series of dozens of runs under load of the timing-sensitive tests (AP-115), at least E2S-13, E2S-17, E2S-11 and E2S-09; the order check of section 13 on the two real files (smoke picker, picker smoke); npm run check once at the end. Real Chrome: one run at a time, never several Chrome runs at once. (3) Mutants: apply at least 20 of the design list of section 16 yourself, choosing others than the ones the designer reports first where you can, plus several of your own around the code changed since the design (O14 self-ended stand with any code; the explicit start outcome and the optional capture group to URL_REFUSED; withStand cleanupError rules; NUL in env and cwd; the timeout range 1..2147483647; the guarded STAND_START_EXITED). Only on COPIES outside the project; hash every file of the working tree before and after and show they are equal; a mutant must not hang the run (AP-116). Say for each which tests went red. S22 is the recorded survivor (decisions/0109 O13); any other survivor is a finding. (4) The replacement table of section 12: every row against the file; the number of test( and assert. in tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js is not lower than at the tag base/E2E105-20261105-01 (the designer reports 59 and 534 at the tag, 59 and 535 now); the prohibitions E2K-50, E2K-41 and E2K-60 guard are not weakened. (5) Judge the designer's departures in the step-5 handoff result.issues and say for each whether it is acceptable or a finding: I1 (criterion 6 checked on the JSON answers by whole string values, the substring check kept for the page text and A's solution names - is a leak of A's data to B still caught?), I2 (E2S-13 holds the exit event of the real child through deps.spawn until child-term is logged - does it weaken N18, is S02 still red?), I3 (E2S-01 and E2S-17 wait for the later link lines), I4 (P06 needs two places), I6 (long timers in a child process, every test stops its own stands in finally), I7 (the reading of the focus rule of criterion 4 after a load). I11 (temporary folders left by released test files outside this work) is outside the scope: note it only. (6) Report the duration_ms of npm run -s e2e -- picker (the criterion limit is 80000 ms; a runner time above 48000 ms is a question for the owner at step 9).

RULES: do not change any project file and do not commit, push or pull; the verdict goes only into this handoff. Kill processes only by explicit pid and only your own: the ten old node processes that run on this machine (two 'node stand.js' with a working folder outside the project, eight 'node -e setInterval') are not yours, leave them; check at the end that no picker server, stand-in or Chrome of yours is left and no sai-e2e- folder. Temporary folders only outside the project. The handoff holds no absolute machine paths and no names of the owner's other projects.

summary.verdict_reason: FAIL at item 3 of Step 5b (do the tests catch an error), for criterion 6 (Q8). Two own mutants of the server that put a text of tenant A into the questionnaire answer of tenant B survive the test `isolation` in both tenant pairs. W02 (a whole text of A as a value in B's answer) survives because the set 'texts of A that B does not have' is computed from B's served questionnaire, the answer under test: the leaked text leaves the set (49 -> 48, 23 -> 22), so neither the card check nor the check of B's questionnaire answer can fail for it (finding F1, High). W01 (a text of A inside a string of B) survives because of the departure I1: the JSON answers are compared by whole string values for every text, wider than the two single common words that are its measured reason (finding F2, Medium). Everything else holds: every criterion has a runnable test, no skip, the failure tests check the state, the tests run alone and in any order, all my runs are green (also under load), the replacement table holds and the counts are not lower than at the tag, 52 of the 53 design mutants I applied are red (S22 the recorded survivor). A Low gap of the starter tests is F3 (V12, V13). The rework is in one test and its two helpers of tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js (and, for F3, a few assertions of tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js).

summary.item_1_reading: Read by me: the four new files and the edits of e2e-kit.test.js. No skip, todo, skip word, option or '|| true'; no sandbox flag; no secret shape; no absolute machine path; search for the names of other projects and computer paths -> empty. Every wait is for a fact with a limit (until 20 ms polls, within, waitGone 5 s, the page's waitFor); the only stretches of time are the fixture spec that must hang (sleep-stand.e2e.js, stopped by the runner at 4000 ms) and the three elapsed-time bounds of the design (E2S-04, E2S-10, E2S-14). After a stop or a kill the tests wait for ESRCH of the pid and the group with waitGone; the single kill(pid, 0) of E2S-13 checks that the child is alive before stop(), not after a kill. Failure tests check the state: storage byte-equal (no connection), five hashes and the card still opening (not found), registrations, folders, spawn counts and processes (E2S-02..E2S-13). Each test has its own stand, browser, scratch folder and log.

issues.text: For ORCH: the cause of F1 is in design 4.4 (exclusiveStrings(qA, qB) with qB served) and in the words of criterion 6 ('that do not occur in the questionnaire of tenant B'); the fix reads 'the questionnaire of tenant B' as B's tenant file, which keeps the words of the criterion and its meaning. The step-05 proposal I1 (DOC-UPDATER rewords 'hold none of them' to whole values) changes the meaning of a Q8 criterion; with F2 fixed it is not needed.

An oracle set computed from the answer under test ('texts of A that the served B does not have') cannot see a leak into that answer, and a control that counts the set ('at least 10') shows only that the set is not empty, not that the check can fail. The proof that a leak check can fail is a mutant that leaks one value (W02), not the count.
